pr_title: Fix TextEdit/CodeEdit crash with invalid caret position.

issue_context.title: Executing `CodeEdit` functions crashes Godot
issue_context.body:
### Godot version

4.0.beta.custom_build. a4c2d8dc7

### System information

Ubuntu 22.10 - AMD RX 470, Gnome shell 43 X11

### Issue description

When executing
```
 extends Node
func _process(delta):

	var temp_variable382 = CodeEdit.new()
	add_child(temp_variable382)
	temp_variable382.set_highlight_matching_braces_enabled(true)
	temp_variable382.begin_complex_operation()
	temp_variable382.do_indent()
	temp_variable382.do_indent()
	temp_variable382.unindent_lines()
	temp_variable382.undo()
	temp_variable382.queue_free()
```

Memory leaks or asan backtraces are visibe when using Godot build with sanitizers support - https://github.com/qarmin/GodotBuilds/actions (linux -> linux-editor-sanitizers)

comments: Complex operations must be ended before doing UndoRedo, so the crash might be related to this. `queue_free()` shouldn't have anything to do with the crash.

review_comments: If @Paulb23 doesn't like that approach, maybe we can make this an `ERR_FAIL_COND` instead, so it still fixes the crash but points that there's something fishy?
